title: A time-only excursion estimate does not price its terminal exchange reward
statement: With frozen ordinary labels during a single-token deleted excursion, ordinary restoration transfers exactly one identity to the old token terminal type; use ACTUAL FIRST terminal event and retain persistent phase/marked outputs. Nonnegative supersolution -Q_y psi_i>=h_i and entrance sum<=b_i y_i bound terminal trace exchange intensity; y_i=0 needs no division. Time-only holding can stay bounded while terminal exchange reward grows. Uphill-only charging uses sum of marked exit rewards with actual post-types, not one phase indicator when outputs differ; rank-nonincreasing exits may stay unbounded adapted extras.
